messages:
alex_g: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to consolidate rate-limit headers, quota examples, and the metering dashboard panel mapping. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4021

tanya_docs: Nice. Is this the PR that also swaps the old /usage samples for the new tiered-metering snippets?

alex_g: Yep. I moved the examples into a new `metering/` folder and added an SDK snippet for Python and TS.

maria_sdks: Quick note: the TypeScript snippet uses the old `client.createUsage()` method. I pushed a tiny commit suggestion to replace with `client.recordConsumption()` — we deprecated createUsage in v2.

ken_metrics: Question on the dashboard mapping — the PR maps `metering.tokens_total` to the panel, but for quotas we need `quota.window_consumed` (prometheus: `quota_window_consumed_total`). Should we include both and annotate when to use each?

sophia_eng: Agree with Ken. Also we should call out how burst credits affect the panel: the visible token usage might be > quota for short bursts, but the billing meter uses consumed+burst_deduction. I added a short blurb in the PR comments.

alex_g: Good catch. I can add a footnote in the panel JSON and a short example in the docs. Example text I plan to add:

```
# Example: interpreting the usage panel
# - `metering.tokens_total` shows raw tokens served.
# - `quota.window_consumed` shows tokens counted against the current quota window.
# - short bursts may make tokens_total > quota.window_consumed; billing uses the latter plus explicit burst credit deductions.
```

maria_sdks: For SDK snippets, can we show the header flow? e.g. client example that reads rate limit headers and falls back?

tanya_docs: Yes please. Something compact: 3-4 lines for detection + fallback TTL config. Also add a note about exponential backoff for 429 vs immediate fallthrough for 503.

alex_g: Draft TS snippet I added in the PR: 

```ts
const res = await redwoodClient.generate({model: 'open-13b', prompt});
const remaining = res.headers.get('x-ratelimit-remaining');
if (remaining && Number(remaining) < 10) {
  // switch to lower-cost model variant
  await redwoodClient.generate({model: 'open-6b-quant', prompt});
}
```

ken_metrics: Can you also include the prometheus query we use for the panel? I suggest: `sum(rate(metering_tokens_total[5m])) by (customer_tier)` — and a note to use `increase()` for long-range reports.

sophia_eng: Also add a short troubleshooting section: common misreads (panel using aggregated vs per-customer metrics), and link to the telemetry schema: https://internal.redwood.ai/telemetry/metering-schema (placeholder).

alex_g: Will do. One more ask: docs-bot, can you run the PR checklist and remind reviewers on expiration of old snippets?

docs-bot: PR checklist run: spellcheck ✅, code-snippets lint ✅, broken-links scan ⚠️ (1 link to internal placeholder), examples tests pending. Tagging @tanya_docs and @maria_sdks for snippet review.

tanya_docs: I'll take snippet review today, Maria can do SDK behavior & edge-cases.

maria_sdks: On it. I'll also add an example showing header parsing for burst credit fields: `x-quota-burst-remaining` and `x-quota-window-reset` so integrators can surface graceful UI messaging.

alex_g: Perfect. After you both sign off I'll squash the commits and merge. If anyone wants a short blurb for the release notes (docs/PR summary), drop it here.

sophia_eng: Suggest: "Clarified metering vs quota metrics, added SDK consumption snippets, and clarified burst credit behavior on dashboards."

ken_metrics: +1

alex_g: Thanks all :tada:
